comment: Repositories the survey must never collect, by exact name.
Since the collector reads the owned listing, a private repository is
catalogued and published like any other. That is the point of it, and it
is also the risk: a card on a public site carries the name, description,
file paths and commit counts of whatever is listed.
A name here is dropped before any request is made for it, so nothing
about it reaches out/raw.json, the catalogue, or the site. Excluding is
cheaper than regretting: add first, remove once you are sure.
